import pandas as pd
import numpy as np
import matplotlib.pyplot as plt

CATEGORIES = ["Electronics", "Clothing", "Home Decor", "Automotive", "Books"]


def _to_category_series(values):
    series = values.copy() if isinstance(values, pd.Series) else pd.Series(values)

    # If the input looks like a plain ordered sequence, assign the predefined categories.
    if len(series.index) == len(CATEGORIES) and not any(idx in CATEGORIES for idx in series.index):
        series.index = CATEGORIES

    series = pd.to_numeric(series, errors="coerce")
    return series.reindex(CATEGORIES)


def task_func(s1, s2):
    s1 = _to_category_series(s1)
    s2 = _to_category_series(s2)

    mask = (s1 > 200) & (s2 > 200)
    if not mask.any():
        return None, 0.0

    cats = [cat for cat in CATEGORIES if bool(mask.loc[cat])]
    v1 = s1.loc[cats].to_numpy(dtype=float)
    v2 = s2.loc[cats].to_numpy(dtype=float)

    fig, ax = plt.subplots()
    x = np.arange(len(cats))
    width = 0.35

    ax.bar(x - width / 2, v1, width, label="Store 1")
    ax.bar(x + width / 2, v2, width, label="Store 2")

    ax.set_xticks(x)
    ax.set_xticklabels(cats, rotation=45, ha="right")
    ax.set_ylabel("Sales")
    ax.set_title("Sales Comparison for Categories Exceeding Threshold")
    ax.legend()
    fig.tight_layout()

    distance = float(np.linalg.norm(v1 - v2))
    return ax, distance
